entities.summary: The Scaligero Castle or Scaligero Castle of Sirmione is a fortress from the Scaliger era, an access point to the historical centre of Sirmione, on Lake Garda. It is one of Italy's best-preserved castles. In 2019, it was the 22nd most visited attraction in Italy, with 308,459 visitors.
